function quietError(s,cells=s.cells){const dark=range(cells.length).filter(i=>cells[i]===1),white=range(cells.length).filter(i=>cells[i]!==1);if(dark.some(i=>adj(i,s.n).some(j=>dark.includes(j))))return'Shaded cells cannot share an edge.';if(!connected(white,s.n))return'All white cells must stay connected.';for(let k=0;k<s.count;k++)if(dark.filter(i=>s.regions[i]===k).length!==s.quotas[k])return`Room ${String.fromCharCode(65+k)} needs ${s.quotas[k]} shaded cells.`;for(const horizontal of [true,false])for(let line=0;line<s.n;line++){let rooms=[];for(let k=0;k<s.n;k++){const i=horizontal?line*s.n+k:k*s.n+line;if(dark.includes(i)){rooms=[];continue}const region=s.regions[i];if(rooms.at(-1)!==region)rooms.push(region);if(rooms.length>2)return`An uninterrupted white ${horizontal?'row':'column'} crosses more than two rooms.`}}return null}

function creditSetup(r,l){const workers=3+l,children=2+l,jobs=[{id:0,parent:null,owner:0,depth:0,children:[]}];for(let i=0;i<children;i++){const id=jobs.length;const owner=1+r.int(workers-1);jobs.push({id,parent:0,owner,depth:1,children:[]});jobs[0].children.push(id)}for(let p=1;p<=children;p++){const count=1+r.int(2);for(let k=0;k<count;k++){const id=jobs.length;let owner=r.int(workers);if(owner===jobs[p].owner)owner=(owner+1)%workers;jobs.push({id,parent:p,owner,depth:2,children:[]});jobs[p].children.push(id)}}if(l===2){for(const p of r.shuffle(jobs.filter(j=>j.depth===2)).slice(0,2)){const id=jobs.length;let owner=r.int(workers);if(owner===p.owner)owner=(owner+1)%workers;jobs.push({id,parent:p.id,owner,depth:3,children:[]});p.children.push(id)}}return{workers,jobs}}

distinctMechanicReview.difference: Anchor Stacks merges captured enemy layers and jumps exactly its current height, then erases components lacking a neutral anchor. Here a capture deletes all enemy contents permanently, the first occupied ray stops travel, height only limits victim strength, and mandatory-first/two-action turns plus survival of three exposed top types alter the decision structure. Four Step Menagerie has four actions, trap support and strength freezing; none of those transitions occur here.

existingComparisons.difference: Captures remove the opposing stack permanently rather than merge both armies; travel stops at the first occupied hex ray and is not exact-height distance. function raceApply(s,who,m){let side=who===1?0:1,other=1-side;s.runners[side][m.i]=m.next;for(let j of m.resets){let r=s.runners[other][j];r.p=r.back?6:0}}

distinctMechanicReview.difference: Marble Council pushes existing superior inline groups for edge ejection. existingComparisons.actualSourceEndCondition: Three ejections resolves; fifty turns settles ejections×100 plus central presence; no pushes can decide earlier.
existingComparisons.difference: The mover enters from outside; mixed rows shift without a superior group, and line removal/recycling governs reserve exhaustion instead of edge ejection.

existingComparisons.actualSourceEndCondition: Neither player has an anchored legal move; compare controlled stack height.
existingComparisons.difference: No height-controlled stacks or disconnected-island collapse; linear insertion changes all intervening cells and captured rows replenish only their owner.

crossNewComparisonPlan.difference: An outside insertion shifts a mixed occupied row; completed lines recycle own reserves and permanently remove opposing pieces instead of superior-group ejection or anchor collapse. Compared new mechanic: Four actual lower spheres must support a higher socket; finite reserves, promotion and optional exposed-sphere reclamation differ from scalar tower building and moving stacks.

resolvedFindings.rule: A disconnected army is marked ! and expires after its own next action if still disconnected.
